title: Average Time to Portfolio Peak
scenario: Calculate the average time (in years) between a studio's first release and their highest-rated game release.
tableSchema: developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT), games (game_id INT, release_year INT), ratings (game_id INT, user_score NUMERIC)
hint: Find first release year and year of max score.
correctQuery: SELECT studio_name, AVG(max_score_year - first_year) FROM (SELECT studio_name, MIN(release_year) as first_year, MAX(release_year) FILTER (WHERE user_score = (SELECT MAX(user_score) FROM ratings r2 JOIN developers d2 ON r2.game_id = d2.game_id WHERE d2.studio_name = d.studio_name)) as max_score_year FROM developers d JOIN games g ON d.game_id = g.game_id JOIN ratings r ON d.game_id = r.game_id GROUP BY studio_name) t GROUP BY studio_name;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT); CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, release_year INT); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, user_score NUMERIC);
